      SUBROUTINE MAT (IELID)
      IMPLICIT NONE
      INTEGER IELID
      INTEGER MATID, INFLAG
      REAL ELTEMP
      COMMON /MATIN / MATID, INFLAG, ELTEMP
      REAL E, GG, NU, RHO, ALPHA, TSUB0, GSUBE, SIGT,
     1  SIGC, SIGS

     1  GSUBE, SIGT, SIGC, SIGS

      NU = 0.3

      ALPHA = 12.0E-6
      TSUB0 = 20.0
      GSUBE = 0.0
      SIGT = 0.0

      SIGS = 0.0
      RETURN
      END
      SUBROUTINE SMA1B (KIJ, IGRID, ICODE, IFFILE,
     1  FACTOR)
      IMPLICIT NONE
      DOUBLE PRECISION KIJ(6,6), FACTOR
      INTEGER IGRID, ICODE, IFFILE
      DOUBLE PRECISION KSTORE(3,3,6,6)
      INTEGER NCAPTURE
      COMMON /CAPTURW/ KSTORE, NCAPTURE
      REAL ECPT(100)
      INTEGER NECPT(100)
      EQUIVALENCE (NECPT(1), ECPT(1))
      COMMON /SMA1ET/ ECPT
      INTEGER IOPT4, K4GGSW, NPVT, ISKP(19)
      LOGICAL NOGOO
      COMMON /SMA1CL/ IOPT4, K4GGSW, NPVT, ISKP, NOGOO
      INTEGER I, J, IPVT, IGRP
      INTEGER GRIDS(6)
      DATA GRIDS /101,102,103,104,105,106/
      IF (FACTOR .NE. 0.0D0) RETURN
      DO 10 IPVT = 1, 6
        IF (NPVT .EQ. GRIDS(IPVT)) GO TO 20
   10 CONTINUE
      RETURN
   20 DO 30 IGRP = 1, 6
        IF (IGRID .EQ. GRIDS(IGRP)) GO TO 40
   30 CONTINUE
      RETURN
   40 DO 50 I = 1, 3
        DO 50 J = 1, 3
          KSTORE(I, J, IPVT, IGRP) = KSTORE(I, J, IPVT,
     1      IGRP) + KIJ(I, J)
   50 CONTINUE
      RETURN
      END
      SUBROUTINE GET_KMATRIX_WEDGE (KFULL)
      IMPLICIT NONE
      DOUBLE PRECISION KFULL(18,18)
      DOUBLE PRECISION KSTORE(3,3,6,6)
      INTEGER NCAPTURE
      COMMON /CAPTURW/ KSTORE, NCAPTURE
      INTEGER I, J, IPVT, IGRP, IROW, ICOL
      DO 100 IPVT = 1, 6
        DO 90 IGRP = 1, 6
          DO 80 I = 1, 3
            DO 80 J = 1, 3
              IROW = (IPVT-1)*3 + I
              ICOL = (IGRP-1)*3 + J
              KFULL(IROW, ICOL) = KSTORE(I, J, IPVT,
     1          IGRP)
   80       CONTINUE
   90     CONTINUE
  100 CONTINUE
      RETURN
      END
      SUBROUTINE SAXB (A, B, C)
      IMPLICIT NONE
      REAL A(3), B(3), C(3)
      C(1) = A(2)*B(3) - A(3)*B(2)
      C(2) = A(3)*B(1) - A(1)*B(3)
      C(3) = A(1)*B(2) - A(2)*B(1)
      RETURN
      END
      FUNCTION SADOTB (A, B)
      IMPLICIT NONE
      REAL SADOTB
      REAL A(3), B(3)
      SADOTB = A(1)*B(1) + A(2)*B(2) + A(3)*B(3)
      RETURN
      END
      SUBROUTINE KPLTST (P1, P2, P3, P4)
      IMPLICIT NONE
      REAL P1(3), P2(3), P3(3), P4(3)
      RETURN
      END
      SUBROUTINE TRANSD (ICSID, T)
      IMPLICIT NONE
      INTEGER ICSID
      DOUBLE PRECISION T(9)
      T(1)=1.0D0; T(2)=0.0D0; T(3)=0.0D0
      T(4)=0.0D0; T(5)=1.0D0; T(6)=0.0D0
      T(7)=0.0D0; T(8)=0.0D0; T(9)=1.0D0
      RETURN
      END
      SUBROUTINE MESAGE (ICODE, IMSG, IPARM)
      IMPLICIT NONE
      INTEGER ICODE, IMSG, IPARM(2)
      INTEGER OUT, SYSBUF
      LOGICAL NOGO
      COMMON /SYSTEM/ SYSBUF, OUT, NOGO
      WRITE(OUT,*) 'MESAGE code=', ICODE, ' msg=', IMSG
      RETURN
      END
      SUBROUTINE WRITE (IFILE, BUF, NWORDS, IFLG)
      IMPLICIT NONE
      INTEGER IFILE, NWORDS, IFLG
      REAL BUF(1)
      RETURN
      END
      SUBROUTINE HMAT (NECPT)
      IMPLICIT NONE
      INTEGER NECPT(4)
      REAL MATBUF(7)
      COMMON /HMTOUT/ MATBUF
      MATBUF(1) = 50.0
      RETURN
      END
